verdict.rationale: Rootly's Workflows engine is explicitly described as 'Rootly's automation engine' that runs structured actions automatically based on trigger events, run conditions, and actions, with 152 documented action types spanning Slack, Jira, on-call, AI, and incident operations, enabling background automations like auto-creating channels, notifying stakeholders, filing tickets, and starting retros 'the same way every time' without manual intervention. This is reinforced by AI SRE, which autonomously investigates alerts/incidents and produces diagnoses, and MCP server access letting AI agents take action programmatically. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that workflows reliably run unattended at scale, and no case studies quantifying autonomous automation outcomes beyond vendor docs.
